title: useRefinementList: eslint fails with error "Avoid referencing unbound methods which may cause unintentional scoping of this"
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When using `useRefinementList` as per [documentation](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/refinement-list/react-hooks/#hook) there is `@typescript-eslint` error:

```
Avoid referencing unbound methods which may cause unintentional scoping of `this`
```

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

1. enable [@typescript-eslint/recommended-requiring-type-checking](https://typescript-eslint.io/linting/configs#recommended-requiring-type-checking) in the project
2. use the following code:
   ```ts
   const { refine } = useRefinementList({ attribute: 'brand' });
   ```
3. run eslint and see output:
   ```
   Error: Avoid referencing unbound methods which may cause unintentional scoping of `this`.
   If your function does not access `this`, you can annotate it with `this: void`, or consider using an arrow function instead.  @typescript-eslint/unbound-method
   ```

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/embed/heuristic-chihiro-f2nv7x?fontsize=14\&hidenavigation=1\&theme=dark

### 💭 Expected behavior

Eslint check pass

### Package version

algoliasearch 4.16.0 react-instantsearch-hooks-web 6.42.0

### Operating system

macOS 13.1

### Browser

Chrome/112.0.0.0
